model.units: model continuous activity; not spikes or calcium

coordinateSystem.projection: experimental uniform axial hex grid, 2.3 degrees spacing
coordinateSystem.interpretation: Experimental camera sampling geometry, not a measured whole-eye fly projection. Reusing the model for a left camera does not create an anatomical left-eye model. Subtype names are not calibrated body-relative directions.

spatialMetadata.interpretation: Signed continuous model activity. Delta is raw minus the declared reference baseline; no clipping, normalization, motor command, or higher visual neuron is added.

baseline.units: model continuous activity; not spikes or calcium
